text:
Here is the test suite in Gherkin (BDD DSL) notation:

```gherkin
Feature: Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Doctors and Chemists/Labs

  Scenario: Add Doctor Screen
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is open
    When the Add Doctor button is clicked
    Then the Add Doctor Screen is displayed with the following fields:
      | Field Name | Field Value |
      | Doctor Id  | generated   |
      | Doctor Name|             |
      | Age        |             |
      | Sex        |             |
      | Qualification|             |
      | Experience |             |

  Scenario: Edit/Update Doctor Screen
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is open
    And the Edit/Update Doctor button is clicked
    When the Doctor Id field is filled with "12345"
    Then the Doctor Name field is displayed with the value "John Doe"
    And the Age field is displayed with the value "30"
    And the Sex field is displayed with the value "Male"
    And the Qualification field is displayed with the value "MBBS"
    And the Experience field is displayed with the value "10 years"

  Scenario: Add Chemist/Lab Screen
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is open
    When the Add Chemist/Lab button is clicked
    Then the Add Chemist/Lab Screen is displayed with the following fields:
      | Field Name | Field Value |
      | Chemist/Lab Id | generated   |
      | Chemist/Lab Flag |             |
      | Chemist Lab Name |             |
      | Chemist Lab Address |             |
      | Chemist Lab Contact Details |             |

  Scenario: Edit/Update Chemist/Lab Screen
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is open
    And the Edit/Update Chemist/Lab button is clicked
    When the Chemist/Lab Id field is filled with "67890"
    Then the Chemist/Lab Flag field is displayed with the value "Yes"
    And the Chemist Lab Name field is displayed with the value "ABC Chemist"
    And the Chemist Lab Address field is displayed with the value "123 Main St"
    And the Chemist Lab Contact Details field is displayed with the value "1234567890"

  Scenario: Add Doctor with invalid data
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is open
    When the Add Doctor button is clicked
    And the Doctor Name field is filled with "John"
    And the Age field is filled with "abc"
    Then an error message is displayed with the text "Invalid data"

  Scenario: Edit/Update Doctor with invalid data
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is open
    And the Edit/Update Doctor button is clicked
    When the Doctor Id field is filled with "12345"
    And the Doctor Name field is filled with "John"
    And the Age field is filled with "abc"
    Then an error message is displayed with the text "Invalid data"

  Scenario: Delete Doctor with open consultation requests
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is open
    And the Delete Doctor button is clicked
    When the Doctor Id field is filled with "12345"
    Then an error message is displayed with the text "Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete"

  Scenario: Delete Doctor with no open consultation requests
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is open
    And the Delete Doctor button is clicked
    When the Doctor Id field is filled with "12345"
    Then the Doctor is deleted successfully

  Scenario: Add Chemist/Lab with invalid data
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is open
    When the Add Chemist/Lab button is clicked
    And the Chemist Lab Name field is filled with "ABC Chemist"
    And the Chemist Lab Address field is filled with "123 Main St"
    And the Chemist Lab Contact Details field is filled with "abc"
    Then an error message is displayed with the text "Invalid data"

  Scenario: Edit/Update Chemist/Lab with invalid data
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is open
    And the Edit/Update Chemist/Lab button is clicked
    When the Chemist/Lab Id field is filled with "67890"
    And the Chemist Lab Name field is filled with "ABC Chemist"
    And the Chemist Lab Address field is filled with "123 Main St"
    And the Chemist Lab Contact Details field is filled with "abc"
    Then an error message is displayed with the text "Invalid data"

  Scenario: Speciality does not exist
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is open
    When the Speciality Id field is filled with "12345"
    Then an error message is displayed with the text "Speciality does not exist"

  Scenario: Doctor does not exist
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is open
    When the Doctor Id field is filled with "12345"
    Then an error message is displayed with the text "Doctor does not exist"
```

And here is the JSON list of test cases:

```json
[
  {"id": "TC-001", "title": "Add Doctor Screen", "req_ids": ["VCMDR02"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["Administrators Menu Screen is open"], "inputs": {"name": "value"}, "steps": ["Add Doctor button is clicked", "Add Doctor Screen is displayed"], "expected": ["Add Doctor Screen is displayed with the following fields: | Field Name | Field Value |"]},
  {"id": "TC-002", "title": "Edit/Update Doctor Screen", "req_ids": ["VCMDR03-1"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["Administrators Menu Screen is open", "Edit/Update Doctor button is clicked"], "inputs": {"name": "value"}, "steps": ["Doctor Id field is filled with 12345", "Doctor Name field is displayed with the value John Doe"], "expected": ["Doctor Name field is displayed with the value John Doe"]},
  {"id": "TC-003", "title": "Add Chemist/Lab Screen", "req_ids": ["VCMCL02"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["Administrators Menu Screen is open"], "inputs": {"name": "value"}, "steps": ["Add Chemist/Lab button is clicked", "Add Chemist/Lab Screen is displayed"], "expected": ["Add Chemist/Lab Screen is displayed with the following fields: | Field Name | Field Value |"]},
  {"id": "TC-004", "title": "Edit/Update Chemist/Lab Screen", "req_ids": ["VCMCL01"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["Administrators Menu Screen is open", "Edit/Update Chemist/Lab button is clicked"], "inputs": {"name": "value"}, "steps": ["Chemist/Lab Id field is filled with 67890", "Chemist/Lab Flag field is displayed with the value Yes"], "expected": ["Chemist/Lab Flag field is displayed with the value Yes"]},
  {"id": "TC-005", "title": "Add Doctor with invalid data", "req_ids": ["VCMDR02"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": ["Administrators Menu Screen is open"], "inputs": {"name": "value"}, "steps": ["Add Doctor button is clicked", "Doctor Name field is filled with John", "Age field is filled with abc"], "expected": ["Error message is displayed with the text Invalid data"]},
  {"id": "TC-006", "title": "Edit/Update Doctor with invalid data", "req_ids": ["VCMDR03-1"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": ["Administrators Menu Screen is open", "Edit/Update Doctor button is clicked"], "inputs": {"name": "value"}, "steps": ["Doctor Id field is filled with 12345", "Doctor Name field is filled with John", "Age field is filled with abc"], "expected": ["Error message is displayed with the text Invalid data"]},
  {"id": "TC-007", "title": "Delete Doctor with open consultation requests", "req_ids": ["VCMDR03-3"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": ["Administrators Menu Screen is open", "Delete Doctor button is clicked"], "inputs": {"name": "value"}, "steps": ["Doctor Id field is filled with 12345"], "expected": ["Error message is displayed with the text Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete"]},
  {"id": "TC-008", "title": "Delete Doctor with no open consultation requests", "req_ids": ["VCMDR03-3"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": ["Administrators Menu Screen is open", "Delete Doctor button is clicked"], "inputs": {"name": "value"}, "steps": ["Doctor Id field is filled with 12345"], "expected": ["Doctor is deleted successfully"]},
  {"id": "TC-009", "title": "Add Chemist/Lab with invalid data", "req_ids": ["VCMCL02"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": ["Administrators Menu Screen is open"], "inputs": {"name": "value"}, "steps": ["Add Chemist/Lab button is clicked", "Chemist Lab Name field is filled with ABC Chemist", "Chemist Lab Address field is filled with 123 Main St", "Chemist Lab Contact Details field is filled with abc"], "expected": ["Error message is displayed with the text Invalid data"]},
  {"id": "TC-010", "title": "Edit/Update Chemist/Lab with invalid data", "req_ids": ["VCMCL01"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": ["Administrators Menu Screen is open", "Edit/Update Chemist/Lab button is clicked"], "inputs": {"name": "value"}, "steps": ["Chemist/Lab Id field is filled with 67890", "Chemist Lab Name field is filled with ABC Chemist", "Chemist Lab Address field is filled with 123 Main St", "Chemist Lab Contact Details field is filled with abc"], "expected": ["Error message is displayed with the text Invalid data"]},
  {"id": "TC-011", "title": "Speciality does not exist", "req_ids": ["VCMSP03-2"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": ["Administrators Menu Screen is open"], "inputs": {"name": "value"}, "steps": ["Speciality Id field is filled with 12345"], "expected": ["Error message is displayed with the text Speciality does not exist"]},
  {"id": "TC-012", "title": "Doctor does not exist", "req_ids": ["VCMDR02"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": ["Administrators Menu Screen is open"], "inputs": {"name": "value"}, "steps": ["Doctor Id field is filled with 12345"], "expected": ["Error message is displayed with the text Doctor does not exist"]}
]
```
